verdict.language_detail: MATLAB (R2016b+, uses export_fig, LaTeX interpreter, axes positioning)
verdict.provenance_detail: Research plotting script comparing Kinetic, Dynamic, and MPC controllers for inverse kinematics results
verdict.purpose: Loads experimental data from multiple .mat files (Kinetic, Dynamic, MPC controllers), computes ISE and RMSE error metrics, and generates a multi-panel figure comparing trajectory tracking and pose errors for a real robot experiment, exporting to PDF via export_fig.
